page.layout: One printed page on the scan: a blank leaf with a pasted bookplate label in the centre, printed upside down, and a library sticker at the lower right. No text block.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank paper leaf (pasted-in endpaper or flyleaf). The only printed matter is a bookplate label in the centre, printed upside down, reading "EX LIBRIS B. M." and below it "C. Jos. M.ª LAIS BF. HIFFON." (partly uncertain; the lower line is rotated and hard to read exactly).
